verdict.rationale: AI Gateway's Dynamic Routing lets you build routing flows, visually or in JSON, that evaluate conditions, enforce budget and rate quotas, and choose models with fallbacks. Fallbacks trigger on errors or timeouts, which covers availability, and routes can be changed without touching application code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of routing by model capability or task type, an explicit example of switching to a cheaper model when a budget threshold is hit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can switch models mid-task by policy — cost, capability, or availability — through gateway routing rules

citations.quote: Instead of hard-coding a single model, with Dynamic Routing you compose a small flow that evaluates conditions, enforces quotas, and chooses models with fallbacks.
Restricting each user/project/team with budget/rate limits
Cloudflare can trigger your fallback provider in response to request errors or predetermined request timeouts.
Directing different segments (paid/not-paid user) to different models
Adjust rules instantly from the dashboard or API — no redeploys, no downtime.
